page_title: REI 0-0 MON | Reims v Monaco 14/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Romain Lissorgue has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
90+3' The corner from Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) is intercepted by the defence.
90+3' Caio Henrique (Monaco) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Monaco.
90+2' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) leans back and sends a volley soaring over the bar from inside the box.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) offside.
89' Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.

86' Sergio Akieme (Reims) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
84' The substitution has been made. Nhoa Sangui (Reims) has replaced Keito Nakamura.
84' Luka Elsner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) replacing Junya Ito.
84' Yehvann Diouf (Reims) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
80' A substitution has been made. Soungoutou Magassa goes off and Lamine Camara (Monaco) comes on.
80' A rebound falls kindly for Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
79' Luka Elsner prepares a substitution. Oumar Diakite is replaced by Amine Salama (Reims).
77' Christian Mawissa Elebi (Monaco) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Caio Henrique replaces him.
77' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
77' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 8:10. The current number of shots on goal is 0:3.
75' PENALTY APPEAL after Takumi Minamino (Monaco) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
70' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
68' Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Valentin Atangana Edoa.
68' Adi Hutter decides to make a substitution. Kassoum Ouattara will be replaced by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco).
67' Adi Hutter has decided to substitute Jordan Teze and he is replaced by Mohammed Salisu (Monaco).
67' Here's the change. George Ilenikhena leaves the pitch and Breel Embolo (Monaco) comes on as a substitute.
66' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
65' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
62' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yehvann Diouf intercepts the ball.
59' Amadou Kone (Reims) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
58' Amadou Kone (Reims) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
57' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
57' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) sends in a cross from a long-range free kick. However, his effort lacks accuracy and the ball sails off the pitch.
57' Keito Nakamura (Reims) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Monaco.
56' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
56' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Monaco earn a corner.
55' The resulting corner from Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) is cleared.
52' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) commits a foul and Romain Lissorgue immediately signals a free kick.

51' What a chance that is! Oumar Diakite (Reims) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the crossbar! Keito Nakamura (Reims) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
48' The referee blows his whistle as Buta (Reims) was too aggressive in his challenge.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45+1' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Yehvann Diouf makes a save.

45' Keito Nakamura (Reims) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
45' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) receives a short pass and produces a low effort from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes a routine save.
43' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Philipp Kohn, who smothers the ball.
43' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) sends a long ball in, but Yehvann Diouf comfortably gathers the ball.
41' A cross by Keito Nakamura (Reims) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
41' Junya Ito (Reims) finds himself some space inside the penalty box and immediately unleashes a first-time effort. The shot sails well wide of the right post.
40' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) was quite harsh and Romain Lissorgue didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
37' Marshall Munetsi rounds off a good move with a layoff to Keito Nakamura (Reims) inside the box, he has a clear sight of goal but sends the ball just wide of the left post.
36' 1:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. 0:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
34' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Junya Ito (Reims), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat.

33' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Romain Lissorgue stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. There is a free kick near the sideline to Reims.
31' Jordan Teze (Monaco) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
31' Great save! Takumi Minamino (Monaco) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Yehvann Diouf.
30' Keito Nakamura (Reims) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
29' Great ball in from Oumar Diakite. Marshall Munetsi (Reims) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker over the crossbar.
28' The corner kick from Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

28' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Takumi Minamino (Monaco) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. The referee blows his whistle, Monaco are awarded a corner kick.
26' A pass by Junya Ito (Reims) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
25' Jordan Teze (Monaco) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Yehvann Diouf comes off the line to clear the ball away.
21' Takumi Minamino sprays a pass out to Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes high over the bar.
20' Yehvann Diouf steps in and intercepts a long pass from Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco).
17' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
14' The ball is laid off to Oumar Diakite (Reims) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players low towards the middle of the goal and forces Philipp Kohn to make a decent save.
12' Oumar Diakite (Reims) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
11' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands.
10' Cedric Kipre (Reims) sends a long ball in, but Philipp Kohn comfortably gathers the ball.
9' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
7' A pass from Jordan Teze (Monaco) is intercepted by Yehvann Diouf and the move breaks down.
4' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) is penalised for a foul. Romain Lissorgue had a clear view and blows his whistle.
3' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
1' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
1' The first half has started.
Monaco will kick-off.
Romain Lissorgue is the one to supervise the game today.
